by: the ontology resolution gate over every ground that names the pattern type
check.population: every construct and record that grounds the pattern type
check.freshness: a verdict stands until the pattern types or a record that names one changes
check.refusal: the gate fails on a ground that names a pattern type that does not exist
check.observation: none: a pattern type is a viewpoint on structure, and nothing observes it while a run executes
check.evidence: fires-and-accepts: a suite plants a ground whose kind exists and whose id does not, and a ground filed under the wrong kind, and passes a well-formed one
check.authority: the pattern type list, which every ground that names a type cites
